primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Safety and tolerability were assessed by treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs), serious TEAEs, adverse events leading to treatment discontinuation.

groups.description: Participants with symptomatic transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) who completed Study AG10-201 and received open-label acoramidis hydrochloride 800 mg orally twice daily in Study AG10-202.
groups.title: Acoramidis HCl

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The Safety Analysis Set included all participants who received at least 1 dose of study drug during the Study AG10-202 treatment period. The Safety Analysis Set was used to summarize all safety data.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: From the first dose of study drug until 30 days after the last dose of study drug. (Maximum exposure reported 84.1 months).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Overall Summary of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events.
